plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0001 · 计算反射相关在一次二进细分中的带符号增量
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0001 · Compute the signed increment of a reflected correlation across one dyadic refinement

brief.zh: 展开同一粗类的两个子类。目标减去代表后是否落在上半模，决定反射是否交换两个子类。该公式供 DR-0002 和 DR-0012 使用。
brief.en: Expand the two children of each coarse class. The upper-half residue of the target minus its representative determines whether reflection swaps the children. DR-0002 and DR-0012 use this formula.
